title: Work IQ: real-time Teams meeting and call transcripts through MCP
summary: The Teams admin paths, PowerShell commands, default state, consumption billing and roadmap targets are supported. One minor qualification is needed: the setup guide describes a Global Administrator setup, but the MCP overview says the Work IQ service principal is normally created automatically on first use.

claims.claim: WorkIQ access is in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting settings > Transcript API access > WorkIQ access.
claims.quote: In the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting settings. Under Transcript API access, turn the WorkIQ access toggle On.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global enables Work IQ real-time transcript access.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global

claims.claim: The meeting Transcription control is in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $true allows transcription under the selected meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: The Teams WorkIQ access setting is tenant-level.
claims.quote: The organizer's organization decides. Work IQ uses the setting of the organization that organized the meeting, not the setting of the app's organization or of the user the app acts for.

claims.claim: The existing meeting transcription policy applies to users, including the organizer.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting. For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: Allowing meeting transcription controls whether transcription can run, rather than independently granting apps access to transcripts.
claims.quote: Turning on Work IQ access doesn't, by itself, give apps a transcript. An app receives a real-time transcript only when these conditions are also met:

claims.claim: The EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess parameter requires the latest Teams PowerShell module.
claims.quote: This parameter requires the latest version of the Teams PowerShell module.
